description: Install one or more add-ons on an NKS cluster (Add-on Manager, k8s 1.36+). Use dryRun=true to preview without installing.

addons.description: One or more add-ons to install

configurationValues.description: Helm values override as a JSON-object STRING (already stringified), e.g. '{"policy":"sync"}'. Defaults to {} when omitted

resolveConflicts.description: Conflict resolution when the add-on touches existing resources: Overwrite (default) | Preserve

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually installing

name: ncloud_nks_install_addons
